stories.title: Qatar urges the US and Iran not to wait for a “perfect moment” on a deal
stories.summary: Speaking at Oxford, Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani called on Washington and Tehran to reach a peace deal without delay. Iran's IRNA reported two missiles striking Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, and semi-official outlets reported no casualties.
stories.label: Developing, reports differ. Reported by Al Jazeera

stories.title: Paraguay's Senate removes Peña, and Pedro Alliana is sworn in
stories.summary: The Senate voted 44 of 45 to remove Santiago Peña over the Ueno Bank collapse, and Alliana became the 53rd president on Friday. Peña is under house arrest, at least 27 people face criminal charges, and his lawyers say the impeachment timetable was too short.
stories.label: Developing. Reported by Al Jazeera and AP

stories.title: Trump names Stephen Miller White House chief of staff
stories.summary: Trump called Miller “one of my most trusted advisors” on Truth Social; he takes over from Susie Wiles from Monday. The change comes as Democrats prepare to take control of the House and Senate in January, where investigations into Miller are expected.
stories.label: Developing. Reported by Al Jazeera

stories.title: Kenyan cult leader Paul Mackenzie sentenced to 200 years
stories.summary: He was convicted over the starvation deaths of 190 children and one adult linked to Shakahola Forest, where Kenya's rights commission counts 448 bodies. Twenty-eight accomplices received 10 to 160 years, and the defence says it will appeal.
stories.label: Reported by Reuters via The Standard

stories.title: US measles cases pass 5,000, the most since 1991
stories.summary: The CDC reports 5,182 confirmed cases this year, about 59% among children and teens, as kindergarten vaccination coverage fell from 95.2% to 92.4%. The CDC counts four deaths, while Pennsylvania reports six in that state alone.
stories.label: Death counts disputed. Reported by Al Jazeera

stories.title: Union settles on Ilse Aigner as candidate for Bundespräsidentin
stories.summary: Tagesspiegel confirmed from the CDU leadership that the Union has agreed on the CSU Landtag president, who would be Germany's first female head of state; the CDU Präsidium meets on Sunday evening and party bodies on Monday. SPD leader Lars Klingbeil said the SPD would “das begrüßen und unterstützen”, and CDU, CSU and SPD have a majority in the Bundesversammlung on 30 January.
stories.label: Not yet official. Reported by Tagesspiegel and ZDFheute

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: Siegmund eyes extra ballots, CDU to judge AfD motions case by case
stories.summary: AfD candidate Ulrich Siegmund, who needs three votes from other groups in December's vote for minister-president, now leaves a second or third ballot open: “Wir haben jetzt eine historische Chance.” CDU leader Sven Schulze said “Wir werden von Fall zu Fall entscheiden” on AfD motions, while the party's Unvereinbarkeitsbeschluss still applies.
stories.label: Reported by Tagesspiegel, with dpa and AFP

stories.title: CDU threatens to block the planned income tax reform
stories.summary: Mathias Middelberg called the plan “nicht zustimmungsfähig” without a workable option model for partnerships. The reform would raise the top rate from 45 to 47% and cut corporate tax from 15 to 10%.
stories.label: Reported by Tagesspiegel (AFP)

stories.title: Bundestag toughens penalties for K.-o.-Tropfen
stories.summary: Drugging someone for rape, sexual coercion or robbery is now treated like using a dangerous tool, raising the minimum sentence from three to five years. CDU/CSU, SPD, Greens and Linke voted for the bill from Justice Minister Stefanie Hubig, and the AfD abstained.
stories.label: Reported by taz

stories.title: PP gives mixed answers on meetings between its lawyer and Koldo García
stories.summary: On Koldo García's claim that PP lawyer Alberto Durán offered him money for information against the government, PP spokesperson Ester Muñoz said “no ha habido ninguna reunión”, while the party leadership answered “No lo sé” on meetings but “con ofrecimientos seguro que no”. Koldo's lawyer has given the court two invoices totalling €242,000, and the PSOE says it is studying legal action.
stories.label: Allegation, denied. Reported by elDiario.es

stories.title: Judge rejects malversación charge against Zapatero in the jewels case
stories.summary: Judge José Luis Calama declined Anticorrupción's request to charge the former prime minister with misuse of public funds. Zapatero remains under investigation for a tax offence, which may have expired, and for smuggling.
stories.label: Court decision. Reported by elDiario.es

stories.title: Guardia Civil estimates 88,146 migrants returned after the Ceuta entry
stories.summary: An internal report dated 27 October says “aproximadamente 88.146” people may have gone back to Morocco after the mass entry of 30 and 31 July, a higher figure than the government gave before. It also counts 862 rescues and 90 deaths, as the Audiencia Nacional investigation continues.
stories.label: Official estimate. Reported by Público (EFE)

stories.title: No contractor for the Eifelstrecke overhead lines, so DB changes its plans
stories.summary: “Für den Einbau der Oberleitungen fehlt weiter ein Auftragnehmer,” despite repeated tenders, while work on 10 tunnels and 56 bridges continues from March 2027. In 2027 there will be no trains between Gerolstein and Euskirchen, and continuous service is expected again from the end of 2028.
stories.label: DB InfraGO statement, reported by Bahnblogstelle

stories.title: Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof gets an extra platform track
stories.summary: A new track 25 with a step-free island platform is to ease the station and separate traffic, benefiting RB10, RB12, RB22 and RE20 services via Frankfurt-Höchst. The station stays open during the works, and no cost or completion date was given.
stories.label: DB statement, reported by Bahnblogstelle

stories.title: IAG now expects its first Boeing 777-9 in 2028
stories.summary: The British Airways parent also expects to take 12 rather than 16 aircraft of other types this year. It is a further sign of the 777X delays that are already reshaping fleet plans at other European groups.
stories.label: Reported by FlightGlobal, paywalled summary only

stories.title: Southwest 737 loses an engine after take-off and diverts to LAX
stories.summary: Flight 3396 from Santa Ana to San Jose, a 19-year-old 737-700 with 97 people aboard, declared an emergency and landed at Los Angeles after 38 minutes. No injuries were reported.
stories.label: Reported by Simple Flying

stories.title: Southwest 737 MAX flew 44 times with undetected storm damage
stories.summary: The tail damage came from gusts of up to 73 knots at New Orleans in May 2024 and “went undetected through a scheduled maintenance check”. Boeing has since required a special inspection after winds of 65 knots.
stories.label: NTSB final report, reported by AirlineGeeks

stories.title: BKA seeks another suspect over explosive drone at Leipzig/Halle
stories.summary: Federal police have issued a public appeal for an unknown person seen on an e-bike near the airport, where an explosive-laden drone was found near the Antonov An-225; two suspects have already been identified. The article dates the find to early August, and only this one outlet was checked.
stories.label: Dates unclear. Reported by aeroTELEGRAPH

notes: Reuters, AP, BBC News, tagesschau, Der Spiegel, Die Zeit, Süddeutsche Zeitung, RTVE, El País, La Vanguardia and Cadena SER could not be reached, so world and politics items come from other reachable outlets. Eurailpress, aero.de and airliners.de returned outdated pages, Bahn Manager failed to load, and the federal transport ministry refused automated access. FlightGlobal showed only summaries. Reports on Ilse Aigner that name Bild as a source were not used. No topic of the day on Saturdays.
